summary: Policy templates are easy to read and change, and imports can never remove a SuperAdmin.

new.title: See every policy template setting
new.text: Opening a policy template lists every setting with its value. Settings that cannot be changed here are shown with the reason.

new.title: Edit policy templates with dropdowns
new.text: A SuperAdmin can press Edit to change durations, what activation asks for and who is notified. A change to many policies waits for your approval.

new.title: See where a template is used
new.text: Used by lists every delegation that uses the template, including those that get it as the default, with the total first.

fixes.title: Imports protect SuperAdmins and break-glass
fixes.text: An import can never overwrite or remove SuperAdmins or Break-glass accounts. Every admin now needs a sign-in name, filled from the tenant's domain when missing.
